query: What explicit priority rules will we use to select or aggregate multiple effects per study (timepoint, measure validity, sample size) and when to prefer multivariate/3-level models?

response.query: What explicit priority rules will we use to select or aggregate multiple effects per study (timepoint, measure validity, sample size) and when to prefer multivariate/3-level models?
response.answer: Prioritize multivariate/3-level models when multiple effects per study are complex and interrelated. Use timepoint, measure validity, and sample size to guide selection, favoring larger, more valid samples. Multivariate models are preferred for comprehensive analysis.
